entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.required_behavior: Remote ref-owner unavailability, partial page progress, concurrent parent updates/deletes, concurrent child writes, lease handoff, and idempotent replay after resume must converge without duplicate action effects.
entries.current_evidence: Release-gated action page, owner routing, transaction-id stability, repair, and durable action job resume tests cover stable routing and retry primitives.
entries.missing_evidence: One production chaos harness must combine remote unavailability, partial progress, concurrent parent/child writes, lease handoff, and resume replay in a single scenario.
entries.evidence_symbol: foreign key action page transaction id is stable for durable page retry

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.required_behavior: Hosted/provisioned insert-source upsert must handle unique owner movement between source read, conflict lookup, grouped conflict guard evaluation, staging, and commit without duplicate unique entries, stale owner writes, or SQL versus typed-plan divergence.
entries.current_evidence: Release-gated local insert-source conflict/upsert parity and hosted mutation-source topology retry exist, but insert-source upsert has no hosted/provisioned native stage protocol equivalent to mutation-source staging.
entries.missing_evidence: Add a production chaos harness or explicit native insert-source staging protocol that revalidates unique owners after topology movement before grouped conflict updates commit.

entries.relational_slices_section: Release parity and production chaos gate
entries.required_behavior: Table-emptying and secondary-index rebuild chaos must combine concurrent row writers, abort paths, stale lease takeover, range repair, durable reopen, and deterministic terminal state assertions.
entries.current_evidence: Release-gated table-emptying worker contention, stale lease takeover, malformed/stale range invalidation, durable job persistence, and secondary-index rebuild lifecycle tests cover individual failure modes.
entries.missing_evidence: One combined chaos harness must run table-emptying and secondary-index rebuild through concurrent writers, abort/reopen, stale leases, range repair, and terminal-state convergence.
entries.evidence_symbol: table emptying worker stale lease lets next worker delete rows and finish job
